patches.value: Iterate the displayed x,y matrices in F003 and divide by r!. For each natural r and i∈I with r≤i, x^r e_i/r!=[(λ−i+1)⋯(λ−i+r)/r!]e_{i−r}=binom(λ−i+r,r)e_{i−r}. If r>i the string reaches e_0 and is killed by x. For i+r≤λ, y^r e_i/r!=[(i+1)⋯(i+r)/r!]e_{i+r}=binom(i+r,r)e_{i+r}; otherwise it passes the last vector and is zero. For r=0 the empty products are 1. These are precisely X_r,Y_r by definition. The displayed binomial coefficients, with nonnegative integer upper argument at least r, are integers. Together with F001–F003 this is every assertion of the asserted conclusion.

N002 supplies an R-basis of M_R with n elements. Apply M001 with A=R, B=M_R and C0=Q to this basis: its scalar extension is a Q-basis of A_Q with n elements, so dim_Q A_Q=n. Apply M003 with A=Q, index type I and constant module family T_Q. The field Q satisfies the strong rank condition by finite-dimensional linear algebra; I is finite with n elements by N001. By F003 each T_Q is finite-dimensional, hence free and finitely generated over Q. M003 gives dim_Q((T_Q)^I)=∑_{i∈I}r=nr. F004 therefore gives n=nr. Since n>0 by N001, cancellation in the natural numbers yields r=1. F003 now gives dim_Q QJ=1, while F001 gives the finite generation, nonzero property and decomposition. This proves all of the asserted conclusion.

Substitute F003 in the direct decomposition of N003 to obtain μ(M_R)=⊕_{i∈I}R(b e_i). The vectors b e_i are R-linearly independent because b≠0 and the e_i are complex-independent by N001. They span by the displayed decomposition, so are an R-basis. Since μ is injective by N002, their unique preimages form an R-basis of M_R. Existentially quantify b to prove the asserted conclusion. In particular no rank-one claim has been inferred from containment in C alone.

Fix any K-linear subspace W⊂V_K and temporarily assume L1 that W is invariant under x and y. Induction on the power shows it is invariant under x^r and y^r for every natural r. Because W is K-linear it is stable under scalar multiples and compositions of its preserving operators. F003 expresses all X_r^K,Y_r^K for r≤λ as scalar multiples of these powers, and T_ij as a scalar times a composition of these operators, since λ−i,λ,λ−j are all in [0,λ]. Therefore W is invariant under every T_ij. Discharge L1 and universally quantify W. Together with F001–F003, existentially quantify the compatible basis β to obtain the asserted conclusion.

F001 proves nonzero dimension and F003 proves exactly the required subspace assertion. L_K is spanned over K by the three induced generators x,y,h, so a K-linear subspace is L_K-invariant exactly when it is invariant under those three operators. Thus these assertions are irreducibility of V(K) as an L(K)-module. The original H001 allows λ=0: then I={0}, every relevant factorial and binomial coefficient is 1, and N005 gives the same one-dimensional conclusion. If p=2 the allowed λ are 0 and 1; N005's matrix-unit argument still applies, with no use of distinct h-eigenvalues in K. Nothing used algebraic closure of K. This proves all of the asserted conclusion.
